verdict.rationale: The evidence shows human-readable REST reference pages for the Admin SDK Directory and Reports APIs, but nothing shows a downloadable, machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or an equivalent). The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path under developers.google.com, so this applicable capability is unevidenced. Confidence is medium because the probe only checked conventional OpenAPI locations, and the pack never addresses whether some other machine-readable format exists.
